name: zfmv_action_play_avi_destructor
description: zFMV_ActionPlayAvi::Destructor restores the PlayAvi vtable, frees mediaPath when present, clears mediaPath, and leaves the object on the base action vtable.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zFMV PlayAvi/source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x463670 validates the MSVC thiscall destructor shape: install the action-PlayAvi vtable, free non-null mediaPath through the CRT provider, clear mediaPath to null, install g_zFMV_ActionBase_Vtable, and return without a value.
The dependency frontier has no authored callees; free is a CRT provider and the EH handler is compiler-provider glue.
The native smoke verifies mediaPath free-and-clear behavior, final base vtable identity, and the null mediaPath scalar-wrapper path that reuses the same destructor.
